verdict.rationale: A training-data policy or opt-out is a fair question for a hosted database service, so the axis applies. The pack has no Turso statement, policy or setting about AI model training. Customer-held encryption keys, bring-your-own-cloud and customer S3 buckets are adjacent data-control features, not a documented no-training commitment or opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
